director.card: Ek chocolate 8 bachchon mein barabar bati, aur utni hi badi doosri chocolate 2 bachchon mein. Farhan 8 waalon mein hai, Gita 2 waalon mein. Farhan ka tukda Gita ke tukde se zyada hai ya kam?

director.text: chhota

Bilkul sahi. Dekho, 8 mein bati chocolate ka har tukda 1/8 hai, 2 mein bati ka 1/2; 1/8 chhota hai, toh Farhan ka tukda kam. Board par teen ek jaisi chocolate hain: pehli 4 barabar tukdon mein kati, doosri 10 mein, teesri 7 mein. Har chocolate ka ek tukda lo, 1/4, 1/10 aur 1/7, aur inhe sabse chhote se sabse bade tak lagao.

director.text: tenth, seventh, quarter

Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki chocolate jitne zyada tukdon mein kate, tukda utna chhota; isliye pehle 1/10, phir 1/7, phir 1/4. Chalo, aaj ka ek aakhri sawaal, poore paath se. Is circle ke 9 barabar tukde hain, aur 4 tukdon mein rang hai. Rangin tukde poore circle ka kaunsa fraction hain?
Sahi jawab, kyunki circle ke saare 9 barabar tukde neeche wala number banate hain, aur rangin 4 upar wala number; bina rang ke 5 neeche wale number mein nahi jaate. Yahan tak theek hai?
pehle wale step se pata chala

Kuch baatein aasaan thi, kuch mein mehnat lagi. Aaj dekha ki sirf barabar tukdon ka fraction naam hota hai, aur neeche wala number saare tukde ginta hai. Phir group ka fraction aaya: neeche wala number barabar group ginta hai, aur ek group ki ginti jawab hai. Aakhir mein dekha ki ek jaisi cheez jitne zyada barabar tukdon mein kate, har tukda utna chhota hota hai. Aaj ka paath kaisa laga?
sawaal achhe the
Har paath mein kuch naya hota hai. Aaj tumne teen chocolate ke tukde chhote se bade tak lagaye: 1/10, 1/7, 1/4. Aaj ke liye itna hi, phir milte hain!
